0001-basic-prose.description: Prose passthrough only (INV-1): a document with no ad blocks renders identically to markdown.

0002-state-and-action.description: ad-state, ad-data and ad-action blocks with roles; the action label carries a degraded {expr} binding.

0003-foreign-block.description: Unknown block types are preserved verbatim as foreign blocks and render as plain code fences (SPEC 2.1).

0004-duplicate-key.description: E_DUPLICATE_KEY demotes the offending block to a foreign block; the document still renders (SPEC 15).

0005-generated-id.description: Generated ids are h<sha1(canonical-block)[0:10]>, stable under canonicalization (SPEC 2.3); when=/each= reactivity.

0006-expr-bindings.description: Level-3 expression language in state entries and {expr} bindings; reactive.html is the state-applied render (SPEC 5/6).

0007-async-regions.description: ad-region phase blocks (pending/success/failure) keyed by an action id; the static render keeps every region hidden (SPEC 4/7).

0008-prose-table.description: GFM pipe tables inside prose render as <table> (header, body rows, alignment colons parsed); prose parsing is renderer-owned (SPEC 9).

0009-chart-and-list.description: ad-chart renders <figure data-ad-chart> with a <table> fallback (array rows + columns, object rows, flat scalars; mixed shape renders no table); ad-list renders <ul>/<ol> from body markers or the items field.

0010-form-controls.description: ad-form controls render SPEC 4.3 validation opts (required, min, max, pattern, maxlength) and value seeds; textarea value becomes initial content.
